title: Build for What Comes Next
summary: The opening film of the 2026 ChronoAI virtual launch: when execution becomes almost free, judgment becomes scarce. A complete vehicle of NyxID, Ornn, CMA, heca and chrono-harness around a swappable engine, mathematics as the stress test, and one Lean theorem: a claim recoverable from the others lowers information escape by zero.
summary_zh: 2026 ChronoAI 线上发布会开场短片：执行趋近免费，判断成为稀缺。由 NyxID、Ornn、CMA、heca 与 chrono-harness 组成、可更换发动机的整车，以数学为压力测试，并引用一条 Lean 定理：可由其余定理恢复的命题不降低信息逃逸。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · cost and judgment curves, a five-layer chassis, a frozen truth DAG
